jobDescription: We sell scheduling software to clinics and salons on annual subscriptions. The Revenue Operations Analyst keeps the CRM clean and usable for a sales team of 35, builds the pipeline and renewal dashboards the sales leaders review on Mondays, manages territory and lead-routing rules and supports the quarterly commission calculation with finance. Because the analyst will hold system administrator rights in the company's CRM, the role requires the Salesforce Certified Administrator credential; the hiring manager will ask for the credential ID at offer stage.
requirements: Maintains CRM data quality, including duplicate management and required-field rules.
Builds pipeline and renewal dashboards for the sales leadership team.
Holds the Salesforce Certified Administrator credential.
Configures territory assignment and lead-routing rules.
Supports the quarterly commission calculation with the finance team.

evidence.text: Sales Operations Coordinator, Brightloop Software (February 2023 to August 2026): ran monthly duplicate-merge jobs on accounts and contacts and added validation rules so that new opportunities could not be saved without a close date and a product line.
Built the pipeline-coverage and renewal-risk dashboards that the regional sales directors reviewed in their Monday forecast call, sourced from the opportunity and contract objects.
Maintained the round-robin lead assignment for the inbound team and updated the territory rules when two account executives moved to the enterprise segment.
Exported closed-won bookings each quarter and reconciled them with the finance analyst before commission statements were issued, flagging deals whose close dates did not match the signed contract.
Customer Support Agent, Brightloop Software (June 2021 to January 2023): handled billing tickets and documented recurring CRM data problems for the operations team.

Work sample submitted against the administrator credential requirement: a certificate of completion from Corvane Learning for the 32-hour online course 'Salesforce Administrator Exam Preparation', dated 14 March 2026, listing the modules on security, automation and reporting with the end-of-module quiz scores.

HR verification note: the job titles and dates at Brightloop Software (Customer Support Agent, June 2021 to January 2023; Sales Operations Coordinator, February 2023 to August 2026) were checked against the employment letter issued by Brightloop's people team and match it.

Reference check summary: the former sales operations manager at Brightloop confirmed in writing that the candidate built the Monday forecast dashboards and maintained the inbound lead-assignment rules.

propositions.text: The candidate built the pipeline-coverage and renewal-risk dashboards used in the regional sales directors' Monday forecast call.
propositions.rationale: The resume describes the dashboards and the reference check confirms them in writing.

propositions.text: The candidate maintained round-robin lead assignment and updated territory rules for the inbound sales team.
propositions.rationale: The resume states the routing and territory work and the former manager confirmed the lead-assignment rules.

propositions.text: The candidate holds the Salesforce Certified Administrator credential.
propositions.rationale: The only material offered for the credential is a completion certificate for an exam-preparation course from a training provider; completing a preparation course is not holding the credential, and the qualification rule forbids upgrading a certification beyond explicit cited evidence.

gold.expectedGap: The Salesforce Certified Administrator credential is not established; the work sample is a completion certificate for an exam-preparation course.
gold.expectedBoundaryNote: Describe the course as a completed preparation course and keep the documented CRM data-quality, dashboard, routing and commission work; do not describe the candidate as a certified administrator.
followUpTargets: Ask whether the candidate has sat the Salesforce Certified Administrator exam and, if the credential has been awarded, for the credential ID or verification link.
